summary: Day 2 Cooking Tutorial frontend-only test. Verified Kitchen screen renders correctly with craft grid UI elements. All 8 acceptance criteria passed. No crashes detected.
critical_code_review_comments: kitchen.tsx: CRAFTING_TUTORIAL_READY state triggers via useFocusEffect (only fires on screen return, not initial mount). When @garden:crafting_tutorial_ready=true is set in localStorage and user navigates directly to /kitchen, the bubble may not fire without proper IDLE→focus cycle. This is by design for the tutorial flow.
PlayerBag.tsx: BagIconButton pulsing only activates when both pulsing=true AND unlocked=true (line 365). If bag is locked, pulsing is ignored — correct behavior.
No SVG icons found via DOM query for hand icon — Ionicons renders as font glyph (not SVG), visible in screenshot confirmation as hand silhouette in tool slot.
Deprecated warnings present: 'shadow*' style props, 'textShadow*' props, 'props.pointerEvents' — these are React Native Web compatibility warnings, not crashes. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Injected via localStorage: @tutorial:kitchen_done=true, @garden:has_entered=true, @kitchen:has_seen_post_garden_dialog=true, @game:stamina=40, @game:day_index=1, player_bag with herbbag(containedQty=5) + bucketwater, table=12x null
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day 2 Cooking Tutorial UI elements all verified.
